title: Lazy loading services
description: Learn how to defer loading service code until it is needed to minimize initial application bundle size.

blocks.text: By default, services provided in root are bundled into the main application bundle if they are directly imported. You can lazy load heavy services dynamically using dynamic import() expressions combined with runInInjectionContext.
Use dynamic imports to load heavy services only when a specific user action occurs:

code: import { Component, EnvironmentInjector, inject, runInInjectionContext } from '@angular/core';
// Heavy PDF library and service are only downloaded on click!
